answer: Every epoch each identity must recompute a memory-hard puzzle sized to 4 GB of RAM within one short window, seeded by a beacon that lands without warning. Like an island cut off in a gale, no result can be borrowed from a neighbour: a farm of 200 heads needs 800 GB resident at once, and that plume of rented memory recurs every epoch, while an honest agent spends one laptop for a minute.
